items.name: Path Name
items.desc: The path's unique name (for example path_witness).

items.name: Agent
items.desc: The actor that follows this path.

items.name: Waypoint Order (required)
items.desc: A whole number. Paths with the same number run together; a higher number waits for the lower group to finish. Required: a path without it will not run.

items.name: Create Path
items.desc: Saves the path with the waypoints you have clicked, in order.

items.name: Show (Terrain overlay)
items.desc: Shows the captured terrain as a layer under the map. Capture it with the Events tab's Capture Terrain button.

items.name: opacity (Terrain overlay)
items.desc: How strongly the terrain layer shows, 0 to 1. Default 0.50.

items.name: Zones
items.desc: Shows or hides zones on the map.

items.name: Waypoints
items.desc: Shows or hides waypoints on the map.

items.name: Paths
items.desc: Shows or hides paths on the map.

items.name: Cameras
items.desc: Shows or hides cameras on the map.

items.name: Lights
items.desc: Shows or hides lights on the map.

items.name: Assets
items.desc: Shows or hides placed assets on the map.

items.name: Audio
items.desc: Shows or hides audio sources on the map.

items.name: Agents
items.desc: Shows or hides placed actors on the map.
